- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:1622 | severity=NIT | confidence=3

  WHY: An operator may delete a marker that was already released correctly.

  PROBLEM: The second paginated read of comments re-reads all comments instead of reusing ${comments_file}.
  WHY: It costs one extra paginated read after a successful marking; the reviewer called it a deliberate trade-off, not a failure.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/plan_split_dispatch.sh:177-189 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: release_split() does not return early when the release-marker POST fails, so it still removes ai:split-to-project and restores ai:awaiting-approval.
  WHY: The split marker is left with no later release marker, so /reclarify exits already_split (lines 106-112) with no in-band recovery. The orchestrate.yml step (lines 1616-1618) guards this with `&&`; only the script is buggy.
- scripts/plan_split_dispatch.sh:179 and .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:1616 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Two new GH_RETRY_IDEMPOTENT=true prefixes ride on /comments POSTs, which test_idempotent_marker_never_rides_on_creates (tests/test_workflow_gh_retry_fallback_contract.py:507-515) rejects.
  WHY: The test fails at line 515 (assert offenders == []), which fails tests-promote-stall-and-review and the aggregate lint check, blocking auto-merge.
- scripts/plan_split_dispatch.sh:177-189 and 106-112 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: After a failed release-marker POST and label removal, later /reclarify calls hit the dedupe check and return already_split.
  WHY: This is the same code path as the first MAJOR finding, seen from the recovery side; there is no in-band recovery and the script does not enforce the invariant its comment states.
- scripts/plan_split_dispatch.sh:224-225 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The dedup block does a second full pagination of the issue comments.
  WHY: It doubles the per-split-issue comment reads, against §14; the just-posted marker could be appended locally instead.
- agents.d/7452-plan-split-to-project.md:release_split bullet | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fragment says the failed-marker case warns with the recovery, but the code removes the label anyway.
  WHY: The doc and the code disagree, so an operator will believe the code is safe.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:1621 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The recovery warning conflates a failed marker POST with a failed label removal.
  WHY: Following the message after a label-only failure would delete the release marker and re-enter already_split.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: (1) add `return 1` after the warning block at line 184 (1 line); (2) drop the GH_RETRY_IDEMPOTENT=true prefix at plan_split_dispatch.sh:179 and orchestrate.yml:1616, or use a 3-attempt loop (2 lines, or about 6 per site); (3) append the just-posted marker to ${comments_file} instead of re-paginating (about 3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 5
